content_review.scope: Bounded visual source/reference content review; exact-range pixel verification is separate. No diagnosis or per-clip semantic correctness is established.

observations: CSV declares 360x264 images with near-full-height person boxes. The downloaded source is a 426x240 Toronto street-walk video with approximately 2182 seconds duration; it matches historical title/dimensions/duration metadata.
Frame 91 inside requested 74-114 range is a city-map intro with no visible gait subject.

Frames 150, 205, and 255 in the other three requested ranges show wide city-street views with cars/buildings and small pedestrians, which do not establish correspondence to the near-full-height annotated person boxes.
Exact requested clips are preserved; original CSVs are unchanged. Source/annotation alignment requires independent reconciliation before these four clips are included in ML studies.

content_review.sampling: One midpoint still (zero-based floor(N/2)) from the earliest completed clip per retained source. n93bgWhLZk4 has no complete requested clip, so its available 228-frame source midpoint is sampled instead. This is a bounded representative screen, supplemented by four specified source-frame samples for 2LbERGI34lA.
limitations: One still per source does not establish correct content for every clip or every frame, and cannot verify walking motion or clinical diagnosis.

Absence of another obvious mismatch in representative stills does not establish original annotation-time video correspondence, person identity, bbox accuracy, or suitability for a specific clinical ML study.
Exact frame-range/pixel verification is a separate exhaustive process. The exact requested 2LbERGI34lA clips remain preserved despite the source-content flag.
The n93bgWhLZk4 representative is from the available source only; its requested 458-frame sequence remains unfulfilled because the source contains 228 decoded frames.
